neighbours.label: A number that counts units in a quantity, strongest as a compound modifier ('a 200 word essay', 'a five question quiz', 'six 20-minute episodes'); the same tasks described without a number stay quiet.
fire: Each student writes a 500 word report on the trip.
The app offers a quick ten question test.
Applicants give a three minute speech.
We ran a 5 kilometre race on Sunday.
The kit includes a 12 page booklet.
There is a thirty second pause between rounds.
She recorded a two hour podcast.
quiet: Each student writes a short report on the trip.
The app offers a quick test at the end.
The course has several online lessons.
We ran a charity race on Sunday.
The kit includes an illustrated booklet.
There is a brief pause between rounds.

notes: Card: '0' x9 (a 2⟦0⟧0 word essay; six 2⟦0⟧-minute episodes), ' five' x5 (five question quiz), ' eight', ' many' (how many words); output suppresses counted plurals (' wins', ' awards'). Exploratory probe: compound modifiers 0.41-0.73; plain counts 'under 200 words' 0.37 and 'five questions' 0.23 also fire, so near misses drop the number.
